text:
maria: Quick FYI — planning SDK v23 rollout TOMORROW 09:00 PT (canary -> ramp). Owners: maria (cutover), aj (canary watch), ben (rollback lead).

maria: Short smoke plan below — please ack if you can own/check any item. Need client-compat sanity and a quick client comms blast after canary looks good.

maria: Canary details: 5% traffic to canary bucket for 30m, then 25% for 30m, then full. Canary endpoint: https://api.redwood-inference.com/canary/v23

maria: Quick smoke checklist (run during canary):
- [ ] run health & version checks against canary
- [ ] run representative prompt set (20 queries) against new client bindings
- [ ] validate embeddings similarity delta < 1% on eval set
- [ ] monitor latency P95 and token cost (alerts configured)
- [ ] confirm rollback command works

aj: I can own the "representative prompt set" and latency monitoring during the canary window.

ben: I can own rollback readiness. What's the rollback command?

maria: Rollback is simply pinning routing back to v22 via our routing API. Example:
```
# rollback to v22
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  https://control.redwood-inference.com/route -d '{"model_alias":"api","version":"v22"}'
```
Make sure you have DEPLOY_TOKEN in your env.

sara: I can draft the client comms (short note: breaking changes, upgrade guide, timeline). Will share draft here ~2h before canary.

tim: I can run the client-compat sanity checks against mobile SDK (iOS/Android) — will test core request/response shapes.

aj: A couple quick questions: 1) Are there any known wire-format changes we need to call out? 2) Does the SDK change default timeouts?

maria: No wire-format changes. We bumped default client request timeout from 10s -> 12s for long-response safety. Documenting in changelog and in the client upgrade note.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by maria for 2026-04-15T16:00:00Z. Canary run id: cny-2246012345. Link: https://deploys.redwood-inference.com/canary/cny-2246012345

ben: Acked — I'll validate the rollback snippet and have a one-liner ready to run in /ops playbook.

maria: Great, ownerships: aj (prompt set + latency), tim (mobile sanity), ben (rollback), sara (client comms), maria (cutover + docs). If anyone hits blockers ping me and @eng-oncall.

maria: Final ask: when you finish your checks, drop a 1-line status here (pass/fail + any follow-ups). I'll hold the rollout if any critical fails. :thumbsup:

aj: Will post status after 09:40 PT canary window.

sara: Draft incoming in ~90m.

tim: I'll run iOS tests 08:30 PT and report.

maria: Thanks all — I'll post a short client advisory once canary passes.
